in_sanskrit.name: राज्नील
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: King of the Blue (god of water)

in_marathi.name: Rajneel
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajneel हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means 'rule' or 'king' and neel means 'blue' or 'god'. This name signifies the king of the gods, Indra. It is also associated with the god Vishnu, who is often depicted riding a blue elephant.

in_bengali.name: Rajneel
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King of the Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajneel একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Raj means 'rule' or 'king' and neel means 'blue' or 'god'. This name signifies the king of the gods, Indra. It is also associated with the god Vishnu, who is often depicted riding a blue elephant.
